name: earnings dashboard card with a stat trio
looks: A dark dashboard card holds a company row and a highlighted EPS block (actual vs expected, with a swing badge), beneath a row of three big stats (two dollar figures and a percentage) each with a small vs-expectation caption.
build: data-infographic: the dashboard card fades/slides up as one DOM panel; each of the three stats rolls its digits up with a vertical blur during the count, landing a beat apart; the swing badge pops with a small scale snap on back.out.
sound: A rising tone under the digit rolls, a soft pop on the swing badge.
prompt: Show a dashboard card highlighting one key figure against its expected value, then reveal a row of three supporting stats beneath it, each rolling its digits up a beat apart with a small caption comparing it to expectations. Keep the whole thing dark and dense, like a real trading terminal.
